syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Its standard / asks for a [second] / off switch.
text.ja: その 安全規格は / [2つ目の] 停止スイッチを / 求めている。

captions.source: UL 1026 (household cooking appliances, toasters included): the 6th-edition revisions added a redundant control and a secondary operating control for cord-connected automatic toasters. InCompliance; Intertek.

text.en: Its kill switch: / a [study], / due 16 November.
text.ja: AIの キルスイッチは / [調査] 中。 / 期限は 11月16日。

captions.source: California Executive Order N-9-26, signed 18 Sept 2026, asks for recommendations, including a frontier-model "kill switch", by 16 Nov 2026. Governor's office; CalMatters; CNBC; CTV.

dateline.ja: サクラメント・州知事令 N-9-26

note.why: a handwritten prop in the leaflet's world; it stays English in every master, and the caption carries it

post.en: A toaster's safety standard asks for a second off switch, in case the first one fails. California's AI kill switch is a study, due 16 November.
post.fi: Leivänpaahtimen turvastandardi vaatii toisen katkaisimen siltä varalta, että ensimmäinen pettää. Kalifornian tekoälyn hätäkatkaisin on selvitys, jonka määräaika on 16.11.
post.ja: トースターの安全規格は、一つ目が故障したときのために二つ目の停止スイッチを求めている。カリフォルニア州のAIキルスイッチは調査中で、期限は11月16日。
